title: Resolving and resetting the charge environment of single T-centers in silicon p-i-n waveguides
summary: The silicon T-center is a telecom-band spin-photon interface in a manufacturable photonics platform. In nanophotonic devices, however, its optical linewidth is broadened by a fluctuating charge environment, limiting photon indistinguishability for quantum networking. Here, we address this challenge through characterization and suppression of the local charge-noise of single T-centers in lateral p-i-n waveguides, demonstrating an unheralded method of T-center optical linewidth narrowing.
